title: Protective Effect of Gut Microbiota-Derived Metabolites on Necrotizing Enterocolitis in Preterm Infants
author: Rong Chen
materials: rat small intestinal crypt epithelial cell line (IEC-6)

Cells (104 cells/well) were cultured in 96-well plates. After 24 h, the medium was replaced. The cells were then treated with different doses of nicotinic acid (NA) (Sigma-Aldrich), lithocholic acid (LCA) (OriLeaf), and LPS (Sigma-Aldrich) for 24 h. A 10 μL CCK-8 working solution (Invitrogen) was then added, and after 1-h incubation period, the optical density values were assessed at 450 nm to determine cell viability. Cell viability was quantified using the formula: Cell viability (%) = (optical density (OD)treated sample – ODblank)/(ODcontrol sample – ODblank) × 100%

Total RNA was extracted from the ileum and colon tissue using a TRIzol kit (Invitrogen), followed by extraction, precipitation, and washing steps using chloroform, isopropanol, and 75% anhydrous ethanol (prepared with DEPC water), respectively. RNA quantification was performed using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA). Subsequently, cDNA synthesis was carried out through reverse transcription employing a PrimeScript RT Reagent kit (TaKaRa). The reaction conditions were as follows: denaturation at 95°C for 1 min, followed by 40 cycles of denaturation at 95°C for 15 s, and then annealing at 60°C for 30 s. The data were analyzed using the 2 -ΔΔCt method.

steps.title: Culture IEC-6 cells
steps.instruction: Culture rat small intestinal crypt epithelial cells (IEC-6) in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.

substeps.instruction: Maintain cells in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Perform passages using trypsin digestion upon reaching 80% cell confluence.

steps.title: Prepare animal groups
steps.instruction: Assign 70 3-day-old newborn SPF-grade SD rats (body weights 8-11 g) into four groups: control (n=10), NEC (n=20), NEC+NA (n=20), and NEC+LCA (n=20).

substeps.instruction: Co-house control group pups with dams for breastfeeding.
House NEC, NEC+NA, and NEC+LCA pups in an incubator (36 ± 1 °C, 45–60 % humidity) and provide formula milk via gavage.

steps.title: Induce NEC and administer treatments
steps.instruction: Perform the NEC modeling protocol for three consecutive days, incorporating treatments for specific groups.

substeps.instruction: Execute thrice-daily cycles of formula feeding (30–50 μL g−1, five feeds per 24 h), hypoxia (4 % O2 / 95 % N2, 10 min), and cold stress (4 °C, 10 min).
Administer a single daily intragastric dose of LPS (5 mg/kg).
For NEC+NA group, incorporate NA (50 mg/kg/d) into the first formula feed each morning.
For NEC+LCA group, incorporate LCA (0.8 mmol/kg/d) into the first formula feed each morning.

steps.title: Monitor animals and euthanize
steps.instruction: Monitor neonatal rats daily for feeding behavior, activity, abdominal distension, diarrhea, and bloody stools, recording survival rate and body weight before the first feeding.

substeps.instruction: Provide supportive care (milk, diet gel, hydrogel, and/or subcutaneous fluid) as needed during the colitis phase.
Humanely euthanize animals showing lethargy or weight loss > 15%.
At the endpoint, anesthetize animals via intraperitoneal injection of avertin (500 mg/kg) and euthanize via decapitation within 30 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and store intestinal tissues
steps.instruction: Excise the intestinal tract from the distal end of the duodenum to the rectum and examine for hemorrhage, necrosis, or pneumatosis intestinalis.

substeps.instruction: Clear intestinal contents gently.
Collect approximately 1 cm segments of ileum (near the ileocecal region) and colon and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Perform histological and immunofluorescence staining
steps.instruction: Process 1-2 cm segments of ileum and colon near the ileocecal region for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Fix tissues with 4% paraformaldehyde, dehydrate, dip in wax, and embed in paraffin using an automatic tissue dehydrator.
Cut sections to 4-μm thickness.
Stain sections with haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) for morphological evaluation and lesion scoring.

For ZO-1 or occludin staining: block sections in 5% BSA for 30 min, incubate overnight at 4 °C with anti-ZO-1 or anti-occludin antibody, incubate for 1 h at room temperature with FITC-coupled secondary antibody, and stain nuclei with DAPI.

steps.title: Quantify protein and inflammation
steps.instruction: Extract and analyze proteins from 10 mg of intestinal tissue.

substeps.instruction: Mince tissue finely and homogenize in ice-cold lysis buffer using an ultrasonic processor.
Remove debris by centrifugation.
Determine total protein concentration via BCA assay and adjust to 1 mg/mL.
Quantify IL-1β and IL-6 following the manufacturer's protocols.
